svg.title: From an integration claim to inspectable evidence
svg.desc: Pin: Identify the program, environment, software artifacts, dependencies, fixtures and intended outcome.. Execute: Drive the declared public interfaces in an isolated environment and retain permission decisions and raw observations.. Evaluate: Apply versioned independent expected outcomes. Preserve passes, failures, blockers and inconclusive attempts.. Reproduce: Verify retained evidence, replay the evaluation, then separately reconstruct and rerun the original systems.. A result applies to its declared profile and artifacts. A self-test, infrastructure qualification and SUT conformance result establish different things.
